\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS BC \\ 2007 SCORING GUIDELINES (Form B)}

\section*{Question 1}

Let \(R\) be the region bounded by the graph of \(y=e^{2 x-x^{2}}\) and the horizontal line \(y=2\), and let \(S\) be the region bounded by the graph of \(y=e^{2 x-x^{2}}\) and the horizontal lines \(y=1\) and \(y=2\), as shown above.
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the area of \(R\).
\item[(b)] Find the area of \(S\).
\item[(c)] Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression that gives the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is rotated about the horizontal line \(y=1\).
\end{itemize}
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/24283358-d3b1-4fe6-937d-5dd658dac105-1.jpg?height=501&width=636&top_left_y=393&top_left_x=1319)
\[
e^{2 x-x^{2}}=2 \text { when } x=0.446057,1.553943
\]
Let \(P=0.446057\) and \(Q=1.553943\)
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Area of \(R=\int_{P}^{Q}\left(e^{2 x-x^{2}}-2\right) d x=0.514\)
\item[(b)] \(e^{2 x-x^{2}}=1\) when \(x=0,2\)
\[
\text { Area of } \begin{aligned}
S & =\int_{0}^{2}\left(e^{2 x-x^{2}}-1\right) d x-\text { Area of } R \\
& =2.06016-\text { Area of } R=1.546
\end{aligned}
\]
OR
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \int_{0}^{P}\left(e^{2 x-x^{2}}-1\right) d x+(Q-P) \cdot 1+\int_{Q}^{2}\left(e^{2 x-x^{2}}-1\right) d x \\
& =0.219064+1.107886+0.219064=1.546
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)] Volume \(=\pi \int_{P}^{Q}\left(\left(e^{2 x-x^{2}}-1\right)^{2}-(2-1)^{2}\right) d x\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { limits } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { limits } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}2: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { constant and limits }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
